rows.text: Selamat petang puan, saya Inspektor Rahman dari IPD Dang Wangi. Nombor IC puan digunakan untuk buka akaun pengubahan wang haram. Saya akan sambungkan puan kepada pegawai BNM untuk siasatan. Jangan beritahu sesiapa.
This is Pos Malaysia. A parcel under your name containing 5 fake passports was seized by customs. Press 1 to speak to the police officer handling your case.
Bro my mother got call from 'Bank Negara officer' say her account involved in money laundering, need transfer all savings to safe account for audit, they on video call now got show warrant
您好，我是警察局的陈警官。您的身份证号码涉及一宗洗钱案件，请您配合调查，把存款转到国家银行的安全账户，不要告诉家人。
Ini mahkamah. Anda ada saman tertunggak dan waran tangkap akan dikeluarkan hari ini. Sila tekan 9 untuk bercakap dengan pegawai.
Join our VIP Telegram group! Our AI trading robot guarantees 30% monthly returns. Minimum deposit RM500, withdraw anytime. Limited slots, register with mentor Jessica now.
Pelaburan emas patuh syariah, pulangan 5% seminggu dijamin. Ramai dah untung. Pindah ke akaun syarikat dan admin akan masukkan dalam app.
The app shows my profit already RM48k but when I want withdraw they say must pay 20% tax first then can release. Mentor say very normal one
老师带单炒股，保证每月收益百分之二十，先充值五千元到APP，名额有限。

Got SMS say my Shopee parcel stuck at customs need pay small fee 3 ringgit using card, the link ask card number and OTP
Kerja sambilan dari rumah! Like video TikTok dan dapat RM10 setiap tugasan. Gaji RM300 sehari. WhatsApp HR untuk mula.
Hi, I'm Sarah from the recruitment team. Rate hotels online and earn RM50-RM500 daily. For the premium tasks you need to top up first, then you'll get commission back.
Already done 30 tasks, they say my account frozen because negative balance, must top up RM2,000 more to unlock and withdraw all my salary

My darling, I'm a US army doctor in Syria. I sent you a box with my savings but customs in KL need a clearance fee of RM8,000 before release. Please help me, I will pay you back when I come to Malaysia.
Sayang, saya terkandas di lapangan terbang, beg dan dompet hilang. Boleh transfer RM3,000 dulu untuk tiket? Nanti saya bayar balik bila jumpa.
I paid deposit RM450 for iPhone on Facebook Marketplace, seller ask pay full first then post, now block me already

Pinjaman peribadi lulus segera tanpa semakan CTOS, RM20,000. Bayar yuran pemprosesan RM800 dahulu untuk pengeluaran.
